text: HEY!!
OVER HERE!
Thank god someone finally came.
zh: 谢天谢地，总算有人来了。

text: I thought I was going to die down here!
zh: 我还以为我要死在这下面了！

text: Are you Themir?
How did you end up here?
I will come back later.
The one and only!
Did Balder send you?
Of course he did.
Wait a second.. You aren't one of his men.
Never mind.
There's more important matters at hand! Get me out of here!
zh: 眼下有更要紧的事！快把我弄出去！

text: You see, there's several magical fountains in this cave.
zh: 你看，这洞里有好几处魔法泉。

text: So I thought, I'd hop right in and be out of here in just a second.
zh: 所以我心想，进来转一圈，眨眼工夫就能出去。

text: As I was about to write down my findings, a goblin stole my staff!
zh: 我正要记下我的发现，一个哥布林偷走了我的法杖！

text: And as if the situation wasn't bad enough, the floor underneath me fell apart and left me stranded here.
zh: 仿佛这还不够倒霉似的，我脚下的地面塌了，把我困在了这里。

text: Do you need help?
I'll come back later.
What the hell do you mean?!
You can't just leave me here!
zh: 你不能就这么把我丢在这儿！

text: I am the only wizard around!
zh: 我可是这附近唯一的巫师！

text: In fact, I may be the only wizard you'll ever see here!
zh: 事实上，我可能是你在这儿能见到的唯一一个巫师！

text: So, if you want any of your questions answered. YOU need me!
zh: 所以，你要是想得到任何问题的答案——是你需要我！

text: What does it look like?!
zh: 你看我这副样子像不需要吗？！

text: What do you need?
Well, I'm not leaving without my staff. It's too dangerous to be left to the hands of some filthy goblins!
zh: 哼，拿不回法杖我是不会走的。把它留在肮脏的哥布林手里太危险了！

text: Besides, it'll make getting out of here a breeze!
zh: 再说，有了它，出去就易如反掌了！

text: Anyway. To the north, there's a little entrance.
That bastard left through that very hole the moment he took my staff!
zh: 那混蛋抢了我的法杖，转身就从那个洞钻走了！

text: Be prepared for him though.
I think he was able to use it, somewhat.
zh: 我觉得他多少能使唤那法杖了。

text: Quite uncommon among goblins, if I do say so myself.
zh: 要我说，这在哥布林里可不多见。

text: I will help you.
Why should I help you?
I am searching for a coin.
I do not have time for that.
By the gods!
Bless you, young one!
Please hurry now!
I really need to get out of here.
What!?
Why did you even come down here then!?
*Sigh*
Fine. I'll spare a few coins for you.
zh: 好吧，我可以匀几枚硬币给你。

text: But not before you get my staff!
zh: 但你得先把我的法杖拿回来！

text: Don't you see, that I am trapped here?!
zh: 你没看见我被困在这儿了吗？！

text: We can talk about whatever when YOU get ME out of here!
zh: 等你把我弄出去，想聊什么都行！

text: Curse you!
Did Balder send you here just to screw with me?!
zh: 巴尔德派你来就是为了耍我吗？！

text: Gah! Leave me be then!
If I have to rot away in this hole, then I don't want it to be with the likes of you!
zh: 就算我要烂死在这洞里，也不想和你这种人待在一起！

text: Hello!
Did you find my staff?

Oh... It's *you*...
What the hell do you want?
zh:
哦……是*你*啊……
你到底想干什么？

text: I found your staff.
I'll come back later.
You bloody legend!
Hand it over!
Hmm...
This is the one! Gods bless you!
I'll need only a second to recover.
zh: 我只需片刻就能恢复过来。

text: Very well. Visit me in the outlaw camp!
zh: 很好。到亡命徒营地来找我吧！

text: I could teleport you out of the cave before I leave. What do you say?
zh: 走之前我可以把你传送出洞。你意下如何？

text: Sounds good.
I still have a few things to do.
Just hold still for a second. It shouldn't hurt, I think.
zh: 站着别动。应该不会疼——我想。
